policy.rule: Every visible feature, action, result, status, and future change must have a human-readable explanation.
policy.unknown_feature_behavior: Never silently invent a feature-specific explanation. Show a generic structural explanation and mark the control as needing dedicated documentation.
policy.result_rule: Separate computed result, assumption/model, unsupported state, and physical/manufacturing sign-off.

title.id: PCB Pro — dari awal sampai hasil
title.en: PCB Pro — from starting point to result

what.id: PCB Pro adalah workspace engineering yang menghubungkan schematic, connectivity/netlist, analisis/simulasi, PCB layout, design checks, dokumentasi, pembelajaran, dan persiapan manufaktur dalam satu alur.
what.en: PCB Pro is an engineering workspace connecting schematic capture, connectivity/netlist, analysis/simulation, PCB layout, design checks, documentation, learning, and manufacturing preparation in one flow.

why.id: Tujuannya bukan sekadar menggambar. Setiap perubahan desain harus bisa dilacak: apa yang diubah, kenapa, data apa yang dipakai, hasil apa yang keluar, dan apa batas hasil tersebut.
why.en: Its purpose is not merely drawing. Every design change should be traceable: what changed, why, what data was used, what result was produced, and what the result cannot prove.

result_levels.meaning: Diturunkan dari data project aktif seperti netlist, geometry, atau metadata.
Hasil solver/model dengan asumsi dan coverage tertentu.
Batas/rating exact part yang punya provenance.
Validasi file/geometri untuk proses produksi; berbeda dari circuit correctness.
Hasil alat ukur/board nyata; level pembuktian lapangan tertinggi di workflow ini.

what.id: Ruang untuk menggambar hubungan logis/elektris antar-komponen sebelum bentuk fisik PCB ditentukan.
what.en: Workspace for defining logical/electrical connections before physical PCB geometry is decided.

why.id: Schematic menjadi dasar connectivity, ERC, footprint assignment, simulator, dan pemindahan desain ke PCB.
why.en: The schematic is the basis for connectivity, ERC, footprint assignment, simulation, and PCB transfer.

input.id: Komponen, RefDes, nilai, pin, wire, net, label, source/ground.
input.en: Components, RefDes, values, pins, wires, nets, labels, sources/ground.

process.id: Editor menyimpan posisi komponen dan wire graph; netlist diturunkan dari koneksi pin yang benar-benar dibuat.
process.en: The editor stores component placement and the wire graph; netlist is derived from actual pin connections.

output.id: Schematic state + netlist yang dipakai fitur berikutnya.
output.en: Schematic state plus a netlist used by downstream features.

how_to_read.id: Wire berarti koneksi elektris hanya bila endpoint benar-benar terhubung ke pin/net yang sama; posisi visual saja tidak cukup.
how_to_read.en: A wire means electrical connectivity only when its endpoints are actually attached to the corresponding pins/net; visual proximity alone is not enough.

limits.id: Schematic belum membuktikan layout PCB, signal integrity, thermal, manufacturability, atau perilaku board fisik.
limits.en: A schematic alone does not prove PCB layout, signal integrity, thermal behavior, manufacturability, or physical-board behavior.

next.id: Rapikan annotation → assign footprint → ERC → Update/transfer ke PCB.
next.en: Normalize annotation → assign footprints → run ERC → update/transfer to PCB.

what.id: Ruang fisik untuk footprint, board outline, copper track, layer, dan connectivity hasil schematic.
what.en: Physical workspace for footprints, board outline, copper tracks, layers, and schematic-derived connectivity.

why.id: Mengubah hubungan logis menjadi geometri yang nantinya dapat diperiksa dan diproduksi.
why.en: Transforms logical connectivity into geometry that can later be checked and manufactured.

input.id: Footprint, net schematic, posisi komponen, Edge.Cuts, layer, track/via, rules.
input.en: Footprints, schematic nets, component positions, Edge.Cuts, layers, tracks/vias, and rules.

process.id: Board model menyimpan geometry persisten dan membandingkan route dengan net schematic.
process.en: The board model stores persistent geometry and checks routes against schematic nets.

output.id: Board geometry + routing state + data untuk DRC/preflight.
output.en: Board geometry, routing state, and data for DRC/preflight.

how_to_read.id: Ratsnest menunjukkan koneksi yang masih harus diwujudkan; track adalah copper route yang sudah dibuat.
how_to_read.en: Ratsnest indicates connectivity still to be physically routed; tracks are copper routes already created.

limits.id: Basic geometry DRC belum sama dengan manufacturing-grade clearance, drill, stackup, impedance, zone-fill, atau fab validation penuh.
limits.en: Basic geometry DRC is not equivalent to full manufacturing-grade clearance, drill, stackup, impedance, zone-fill, or fabrication validation.

next.id: Selesaikan outline/placement/routing → DRC → preflight → fabrication outputs.
next.en: Complete outline/placement/routing → DRC → preflight → fabrication outputs.

what.id: Solver circuit untuk membaca operating point berdasarkan project/netlist aktif dan model komponen yang didukung.
what.en: Circuit solver for reading operating points from the active project/netlist and supported component models.

why.id: Membantu melihat node voltage, device current/power, dan dampak fault sebelum board fisik dibuat.
why.en: Helps inspect node voltage, device current/power, and fault impact before a physical board is built.

input.id: Netlist, nilai komponen, source, model komponen, fault state.
input.en: Netlist, component values, sources, component models, and fault state.

process.id: Solver menghitung state rangkaian; perangkat tanpa model ditandai unsupported, bukan diberi angka buatan.
process.en: The solver computes circuit state; devices without a supported model are marked unsupported instead of receiving invented numbers.

output.id: Node voltage serta device voltage/current/power untuk model yang didukung.
output.en: Node voltages and device voltage/current/power for supported models.

how_to_read.id: Angka adalah hasil model matematis pada kondisi simulasi, bukan pengukuran board nyata.
how_to_read.en: Numbers are mathematical-model results under simulation conditions, not measurements from a physical board.

limits.id: Primary Live Circuit saat ini bukan klaim full transient/time-domain SPICE untuk seluruh device/vendor model.
limits.en: The primary Live Circuit is not claimed to be full transient/time-domain SPICE for every device/vendor model.

next.id: Periksa unsupported devices dan asumsi → bandingkan ke datasheet → gunakan advanced analysis/measurement bila dibutuhkan.
next.en: Review unsupported devices and assumptions → compare with datasheets → use advanced analysis/measurement when needed.

what.id: Visualisasi bentuk fisik board dan footprint bila model/geometri tersedia.
what.en: Visualization of the physical board and footprints when models/geometry are available.

why.id: Membantu menilai orientasi, kepadatan, dan potensi benturan mekanik secara visual.
why.en: Helps visually assess orientation, density, and possible mechanical collisions.

input.id: Board outline, footprint placement, ukuran/model package.
input.en: Board outline, footprint placement, package size/models.

process.id: Renderer menampilkan geometry yang tersedia; data yang tidak ada tidak boleh diasumsikan.
process.en: The renderer displays available geometry; missing data must not be assumed.

how_to_read.id: Gunakan untuk review visual, bukan sebagai pengganti dimension check/CAD mekanik.
how_to_read.en: Use it for visual review, not as a substitute for dimension checks or mechanical CAD.

limits.id: Model 3D yang tidak punya dimensi vendor akurat tidak boleh dianggap bukti enclosure fit.
limits.en: 3D models without accurate vendor dimensions must not be treated as proof of enclosure fit.

next.id: Verifikasi package/height/dimensi exact part dan mechanical constraints.
next.en: Verify exact-part package/height/dimensions and mechanical constraints.

what.id: Daftar komponen yang diturunkan dari project.
what.en: Component list derived from the project.

why.id: Dipakai untuk review part, procurement, costing, dan manufacturing handoff.
why.en: Used for part review, procurement, costing, and manufacturing handoff.

input.id: RefDes, value, quantity, footprint, exact MPN/vendor bila tersedia.
input.en: RefDes, value, quantity, footprint, and exact MPN/vendor when available.

process.id: Komponen project dikelompokkan/ditampilkan tanpa mengarang exact part yang belum dipilih.
process.en: Project components are grouped/displayed without inventing exact parts that have not been selected.

how_to_read.id: Value generik tidak sama dengan part purchasable yang sudah terverifikasi.
how_to_read.en: A generic value is not the same as a verified purchasable part.

limits.id: BOM belum manufacturing-ready bila MPN, package, tolerance/rating, atau supplier identity masih generik.
limits.en: A BOM is not manufacturing-ready while MPN, package, tolerance/rating, or supplier identity remains generic.

next.id: Resolve exact MPN → cek datasheet/provenance → cocokkan footprint → procurement/fab package.
next.en: Resolve exact MPN → verify datasheet/provenance → match footprint → procurement/fab package.

what.id: Tahap mengubah board geometry yang sudah lolos pemeriksaan menjadi file/handoff untuk pabrik.
what.en: Stage that converts checked board geometry into factory files/handoff.

why.id: Mencegah project dianggap siap produksi hanya karena terlihat selesai di canvas.
why.en: Prevents a project from being treated as production-ready merely because it looks complete on canvas.

input.id: Board outline, copper, pads/vias, drill, silkscreen/mask bila didukung, BOM/CPL, DRC/preflight.
input.en: Board outline, copper, pads/vias, drill, silkscreen/mask when supported, BOM/CPL, and DRC/preflight.

process.id: Output hanya boleh dibuat dari geometry source-of-truth dan readiness checks yang benar-benar terpenuhi.
process.en: Outputs should only be generated from authoritative geometry and genuinely satisfied readiness checks.

output.id: Gerber/drill/CAM/handoff jika exporter dan prerequisites nyata tersedia; jika belum, status harus blocked/pending.
output.en: Gerber/drill/CAM/handoff when real exporters and prerequisites exist; otherwise status must remain blocked/pending.

how_to_read.id: Ready berarti prerequisite software terpenuhi, bukan jaminan pabrik akan menerima atau board pasti berfungsi.
how_to_read.en: Ready means software prerequisites are satisfied, not a guarantee that a fab will accept the package or that the board will function.

limits.id: Manufacturing sign-off membutuhkan pemeriksaan file, aturan fab, dan pada produk serius review engineer/manufacturer.
limits.en: Manufacturing sign-off requires file inspection, fab rules, and for serious products, engineer/manufacturer review.

next.id: DRC/preflight → generate → CAM inspect → cocokkan aturan fab → upload/order secara manual/terintegrasi bila benar-benar tersedia.
next.en: DRC/preflight → generate → CAM inspect → match fab rules → upload/order manually or through a real integration if available.

what.id: Tool pin-to-pin untuk membuat koneksi elektris di schematic.
what.en: Pin-to-pin tool for creating electrical schematic connections.

why.id: Wire graph adalah dasar netlist dinamis; koneksi visual yang tidak menempel ke pin tidak dianggap net.
why.en: The wire graph drives the dynamic netlist; a visual line not attached to pins is not treated as a net.

input.id: Pin sumber, optional corner, pin tujuan.
input.en: Source pin, optional corners, destination pin.

process.id: W memulai mode; klik pin → preview → klik pin tujuan. Corner dapat dibuat orthogonal.
process.en: W enters wire mode; click a pin → preview → click destination pin. Orthogonal corners may be added.

output.id: Wire graph + netlist yang dipublikasikan ke inspector/simulator/assistant.
output.en: Wire graph plus netlist published to inspector/simulator/assistant.

how_to_read.id: Net yang sama berarti pin-pin tersebut tersambung secara logis menurut graph.
how_to_read.en: The same net means those pins are logically connected according to the graph.

limits.id: Schematic wire tidak menentukan panjang/impedance copper PCB.
limits.en: Schematic wiring does not define PCB copper length/impedance.

next.id: Run ERC dan lanjut footprint/PCB.
next.en: Run ERC and continue with footprints/PCB.

what.id: Dua cara memindahkan komponen dengan efek koneksi berbeda.
what.en: Two ways to move a component with different connectivity behavior.

why.id: Mencegah user tanpa sengaja menganggap wire masih tersambung ketika komponen dipindahkan.
why.en: Prevents users from accidentally assuming wiring stayed connected after moving a component.

input.id: Komponen terpilih.
input.en: Selected component.

process.id: M/Move melepas koneksi pin; G/Drag mempertahankan hubungan wire sambil komponen bergerak.
process.en: M/Move detaches pin connections; G/Drag preserves wire connectivity while the component moves.

output.id: Posisi komponen baru dengan connectivity sesuai mode.
output.en: New component position with connectivity matching the selected mode.

how_to_read.id: Setelah Move, cek net/wire; setelah Drag, wire endpoint seharusnya mengikuti pin.
how_to_read.en: After Move, re-check nets/wires; after Drag, wire endpoints should follow the pins.

limits.id: Perilaku ini mengatur editor state, bukan efek mekanik nyata.
limits.en: This behavior controls editor state, not physical mechanical effects.

next.id: Periksa connectivity/erc setelah perubahan besar.
next.en: Re-check connectivity/ERC after major edits.

what.id: Penomoran reference designator seperti R1, C3, U2.
what.en: Reference-designator numbering such as R1, C3, U2.

why.id: Memberi identitas unik yang dipakai schematic, BOM, footprint, PCB, dan dokumentasi.
why.en: Provides unique identities used by schematic, BOM, footprints, PCB, and documentation.

input.id: Daftar komponen dan prefix.
input.en: Component list and prefixes.

process.id: Annotation merapikan numbering per prefix dan memigrasikan referensi pin pada wire graph.
process.en: Annotation normalizes numbering per prefix and migrates pin references in the wire graph.

how_to_read.id: Duplicate atau format invalid adalah masalah identitas desain dan dapat memengaruhi downstream mapping.
how_to_read.en: Duplicates or invalid formats are design-identity issues that can affect downstream mapping.

limits.id: Annotation tidak menentukan fungsi atau validitas elektris komponen.
limits.en: Annotation does not determine component function or electrical validity.

next.id: Assign footprint dan ERC.
next.en: Assign footprints and run ERC.

what.id: Pemetaan symbol schematic ke pad/ukuran fisik PCB.
what.en: Mapping from schematic symbol to physical PCB pads/dimensions.

why.id: Symbol yang benar secara elektris tetap bisa menghasilkan board salah bila footprint/pin mapping salah.
why.en: An electrically correct symbol can still produce a bad board if footprint/pin mapping is wrong.

input.id: Exact package, pin count/order, pitch, dimensions, pad requirements.
input.en: Exact package, pin count/order, pitch, dimensions, and pad requirements.

process.id: Picker menawarkan preset; user tetap harus cocokkan dengan datasheet exact part.
process.en: The picker offers presets; the user still needs to match them against the exact-part datasheet.

how_to_read.id: Nama package yang mirip tidak membuktikan pinout/pad sama.
how_to_read.en: A similar package name does not prove identical pinout/pads.

limits.id: Preset tidak menggantikan vendor land pattern/datasheet verification.
limits.en: Presets do not replace vendor land-pattern/datasheet verification.

next.id: Verify pin mapping + dimensions → ERC → PCB placement.
next.en: Verify pin mapping + dimensions → ERC → PCB placement.

what.id: Pemeriksaan konsistensi schematic/project sebelum layout.
what.en: Consistency checks on schematic/project state before layout.

why.id: Mendeteksi masalah struktur seperti duplicate/invalid reference, GND yang hilang, floating two-pin parts, atau footprint yang belum ditentukan.
why.en: Detects structural issues such as duplicate/invalid references, missing ground, floating two-pin parts, or missing footprints.

input.id: Komponen, pin/net, references, footprint state.
input.en: Components, pin/net connectivity, references, and footprint state.

process.id: Rule engine menjalankan check yang didukung terhadap project aktif.
process.en: The rule engine runs supported checks against the active project.

output.id: Daftar findings / clean untuk rule set yang benar-benar dijalankan.
output.en: Findings or clean status for the rule set actually executed.

how_to_read.id: ERC clean hanya berarti tidak ada finding dari rules yang tersedia; bukan bukti circuit pasti benar.
how_to_read.en: ERC clean only means no finding was produced by the available rules; it does not prove the circuit is correct.

limits.id: Basic ERC belum setara full typed-pin electrical semantics semua device/library.
limits.en: Basic ERC is not equivalent to full typed-pin electrical semantics for every device/library.

next.id: Perbaiki findings → rerun → lanjut PCB.
next.en: Fix findings → rerun → continue to PCB.

what.id: Batas fisik board yang akan dipotong oleh pabrik.
what.en: Physical boundary of the PCB to be cut by the fabricator.

why.id: Placement, copper-edge checks, dan fabrication memerlukan outline yang valid.
why.en: Placement, copper-to-edge checks, and fabrication require a valid outline.

input.id: Polygon/segments outline.
input.en: Outline polygon/segments.

process.id: Geometry disimpan pada board model dan dipakai readiness/DRC.
process.en: Geometry is stored in the board model and used by readiness/DRC.

how_to_read.id: Outline harus membentuk board yang valid; sekadar garis dekoratif bukan Edge.Cuts.
how_to_read.en: The outline must form a valid board boundary; a decorative line is not an Edge.Cuts definition.

limits.id: Manufacturing validity juga bergantung pada aturan fab untuk slot/cutout/minimum dimensions.
limits.en: Manufacturing validity also depends on fab rules for slots/cutouts/minimum dimensions.

next.id: Placement → routing → DRC/preflight.
next.en: Placement → routing → DRC/preflight.

what.id: Menentukan posisi/orientasi footprint pada board.
what.en: Defines footprint position/orientation on the board.

why.id: Placement sangat memengaruhi routing, power integrity, thermal, serviceability, dan ukuran board.
why.en: Placement strongly affects routing, power integrity, thermal behavior, serviceability, and board size.

input.id: Footprints, outline, functional grouping, mechanical constraints.
input.en: Footprints, outline, functional grouping, and mechanical constraints.

process.id: Footprint diposisikan pada model geometry PCB.
process.en: Footprints are positioned in the PCB geometry model.

how_to_read.id: Placement selesai bukan berarti layout sudah baik; lihat length, return path, decoupling distance, thermal/mechanical needs.
how_to_read.en: Completed placement does not mean good layout; review length, return paths, decoupling distance, thermal/mechanical needs.

limits.id: Rule heuristics tidak menggantikan constraints exact system/mechanical enclosure.
limits.en: Rule heuristics do not replace exact system/mechanical constraints.

next.id: Route critical nets → remaining nets → DRC.
next.en: Route critical nets → remaining nets → DRC.

what.id: Membuat copper track untuk merealisasikan net schematic pada layer PCB.
what.en: Creates copper tracks that physically implement schematic nets on PCB layers.

why.id: Inilah jalur fisik arus/sinyal pada board.
why.en: These are the physical current/signal paths on the board.

input.id: Pads pada net yang sama, layer, track geometry, width/rules.
input.en: Pads on the same net, layer, track geometry, width/rules.

process.id: Router menolak cross-net endpoints dan menyimpan track pada board model.
process.en: The router rejects cross-net endpoints and stores tracks in the board model.

output.en: Copper route plus updated unrouted/ratsnest state.

how_to_read.id: Ratsnest yang hilang berarti connectivity tersebut sudah direpresentasikan route menurut model; tetap perlu DRC.
how_to_read.en: A disappeared ratsnest means that connectivity is represented by a route in the model; DRC is still required.

limits.id: Basic router/checks belum otomatis membuktikan impedance, EMI, return path, current density, via reliability, atau fab rules penuh.
limits.en: Basic routing/checks do not automatically prove impedance, EMI, return paths, current density, via reliability, or complete fab rules.

next.id: Review critical nets/layers → DRC → preflight.
next.en: Review critical nets/layers → DRC → preflight.

what.id: Pemeriksaan geometry PCB terhadap rule yang benar-benar diimplementasikan.
what.en: PCB geometry checks against the rules that are actually implemented.

why.id: Mendeteksi masalah routing/layout sebelum output manufaktur dibuat.
why.en: Detects routing/layout problems before manufacturing outputs are generated.

input.id: Board geometry, nets, layers, outline, implemented rules.
input.en: Board geometry, nets, layers, outline, and implemented rules.

process.id: Basic engine saat ini memeriksa unrouted connectivity, Edge.Cuts, footprint di luar outline, dan crossing copper antar-net pada layer sama.
process.en: The current basic engine checks unrouted connectivity, Edge.Cuts, footprints outside the outline, and same-layer cross-net copper crossings.

output.id: Findings atau clean untuk coverage tersebut.
output.en: Findings or clean status for that coverage.

how_to_read.id: DRC clean harus dibaca bersama daftar rule coverage; clean tidak berarti manufacturing sign-off lengkap.
how_to_read.en: DRC clean must be read together with the rule-coverage list; clean does not mean complete manufacturing sign-off.

limits.id: Manufacturing-grade clearance/drill/zone/stackup/impedance checks belum boleh diasumsikan bila belum tersedia.
limits.en: Manufacturing-grade clearance/drill/zone/stackup/impedance checks must not be assumed when unavailable.

next.id: Perbaiki finding → rerun → preflight/CAM bila exporter tersedia.
next.en: Fix findings → rerun → preflight/CAM when exporters are available.

what.id: Permukaan/stack tempat copper geometry berada, misalnya F.Cu dan B.Cu.
what.en: Surfaces/stack locations where copper geometry resides, such as F.Cu and B.Cu.

why.id: Layer menentukan hubungan geometry, crossing, return path, dan proses manufaktur.
why.en: Layers affect geometry relationships, crossings, return paths, and manufacturing.

input.id: Active layer + track/pad/via geometry.
input.en: Active layer plus track/pad/via geometry.

process.id: Geometry disimpan bersama layer identity.
process.en: Geometry is stored with layer identity.

how_to_read.id: Crossing visual antar layer tidak otomatis short; crossing pada layer sama antar-net bisa menjadi masalah.
how_to_read.en: A visual crossing across different layers is not automatically a short; a same-layer cross-net crossing can be a problem.

limits.id: F.Cu/B.Cu support tidak sama dengan full multilayer stackup/impedance solver.
limits.en: F.Cu/B.Cu support is not the same as a full multilayer stackup/impedance solver.

next.id: Gunakan via/stackup rules saat fitur nyata tersedia dan dibutuhkan.
next.en: Use via/stackup rules when the corresponding real features are available and needed.

what.id: Indikator hubungan pad yang berasal dari net schematic tetapi belum diwujudkan sebagai route PCB.
what.en: Indicator of schematic-derived pad connectivity not yet realized as PCB routes.

why.id: Menjaga sinkronisasi intent schematic dan layout fisik.
why.en: Keeps schematic intent synchronized with physical layout.

input.id: Netlist + footprint pad mapping + existing routes.
input.en: Netlist + footprint pad mapping + existing routes.

process.id: Engine membandingkan connectivity yang dibutuhkan dengan geometry yang sudah ada.
process.en: The engine compares required connectivity with existing geometry.

how_to_read.id: 0 unrouted berarti semua net yang dikenali sudah punya route menurut model, bukan jaminan DRC/quality clean.
how_to_read.en: 0 unrouted means all recognized nets have routes according to the model, not that DRC/quality is clean.

limits.id: Akurasi bergantung pada pad mapping dan netlist source-of-truth.
limits.en: Accuracy depends on pad mapping and authoritative netlist state.

next.id: Run DRC dan inspect critical routes.
next.en: Run DRC and inspect critical routes.

what.id: Angka yang dihitung solver untuk node/device pada model dan state simulasi saat ini.
what.en: Values computed by the solver for nodes/devices under the current model and simulation state.

why.id: Membantu menjelaskan bagaimana circuit model sedang beroperasi.
why.en: Helps explain how the circuit model is operating.

input.id: Netlist, component models/values, source, solver mode, fault state.
input.en: Netlist, component models/values, sources, solver mode, and fault state.

process.id: Solver menghitung solusi numerik sesuai coverage model.
process.en: The solver computes a numerical solution within model coverage.

how_to_read.id: Selalu baca unit, reference direction, operating condition, dan apakah device model didukung.
how_to_read.en: Always read the units, reference direction, operating condition, and whether the device model is supported.

limits.id: Hasil solver bukan datasheet guarantee dan bukan measurement.
limits.en: Solver output is neither a datasheet guarantee nor a physical measurement.

next.id: Bandingkan ke rating/datasheet → uji corner/fault → measurement setelah prototype.
next.en: Compare against ratings/datasheet → test corners/faults → measure after prototyping.

what.id: Memaksa skenario kegagalan terkontrol di model simulasi.
what.en: Forces controlled failure scenarios in the simulation model.

why.id: Dipakai untuk melihat robustness dan gejala circuit saat open/short/source brownout.
why.en: Used to observe robustness and circuit symptoms under open/short/source-brownout conditions.

input.id: Target/device/net dan fault type yang didukung.
input.en: Target/device/net and a supported fault type.

process.id: Model circuit dimodifikasi secara virtual lalu disolve ulang.
process.en: The circuit model is modified virtually and solved again.

how_to_read.id: Perubahan menunjukkan respons model terhadap fault tersebut, bukan seluruh failure physics dunia nyata.
how_to_read.en: Changes show the model response to that fault, not all real-world failure physics.

limits.id: Arc, thermal runaway, intermittent contact, component destruction, dan parasitic fault mungkin belum dimodelkan.
limits.en: Arcing, thermal runaway, intermittent contact, component destruction, and parasitic faults may not be modeled.

next.id: Gunakan hasil untuk hypothesis troubleshooting lalu verifikasi dengan model lebih tinggi/measurement.
next.en: Use results for troubleshooting hypotheses, then verify with higher-fidelity models/measurements.

what.id: Lapisan analisis lanjutan untuk hal seperti variation/Monte Carlo, thermal/derating, atau model realitas yang tersedia.
what.en: Advanced analysis layer for available variation/Monte Carlo, thermal/derating, or reality models.

why.id: Memisahkan operating-point solver utama dari analisis yang punya asumsi/biaya komputasi berbeda.
why.en: Separates the primary operating-point solver from analyses with different assumptions/computational cost.

input.id: Project/model + parameter analysis khusus.
input.en: Project/model plus analysis-specific parameters.

process.id: Engine lanjutan menjalankan model sesuai coverage-nya.
process.en: Advanced engines run models within their stated coverage.

how_to_read.id: Jangan gabungkan estimate generik dengan datasheet exact atau measurement seolah tingkat kepastiannya sama.
how_to_read.en: Do not merge generic estimates with exact datasheet data or measurements as if they carried the same certainty.

limits.id: Tidak semua part punya vendor models; unsupported harus tetap disebut unsupported.
limits.en: Not every part has vendor models; unsupported cases must remain explicitly unsupported.

next.id: Gunakan exact vendor model/data bila tersedia lalu physical validation.
next.en: Use exact vendor models/data when available, then perform physical validation.

what.id: Katalog exact-part yang memisahkan data vendor terverifikasi dari part generik.
what.en: Exact-part catalog separating verified vendor data from generic parts.

why.id: Mencegah web mengarang rating lapangan untuk komponen yang hanya diketahui jenis/nilai generiknya.
why.en: Prevents the app from inventing field ratings for components known only by generic type/value.

input.id: Exact MPN bila tersedia.
input.en: Exact MPN when available.

process.id: Exact match dapat menampilkan provenance/rating; generic component tetap unresolved.
process.en: Exact matches may expose provenance/ratings; generic components remain unresolved.

output.id: Verified data atau status MPN required.

how_to_read.id: Verified berarti entry punya sumber yang dicatat; tetap lihat revision/date/conditions datasheet.
how_to_read.en: Verified means the entry has recorded provenance; still review datasheet revision/date/conditions.

limits.id: Database lokal bukan live global supplier database dan tidak otomatis selalu paling baru.
limits.en: The local database is not a live global supplier database and is not automatically always current.

next.id: Resolve exact MPN dan refresh data vendor saat part/revision berubah.
next.en: Resolve exact MPN and refresh vendor data when parts/revisions change.

what.id: Assistant yang menerima context project/workflow/simulator/catalog untuk menjelaskan dan membantu tindakan engineering.
what.en: Assistant receiving project/workflow/simulator/catalog context to explain and assist engineering actions.

why.id: Membantu user memahami state project dan langkah berikutnya tanpa mengganti source-of-truth project/solver.
why.en: Helps users understand project state and next steps without replacing the project/solver source of truth.

input.id: Pertanyaan user + structured context yang tersedia.
input.en: User question plus available structured context.

process.id: LLM/provider atau fallback mengolah context dan harus membedakan fakta project, model, dan asumsi.
process.en: The LLM/provider or fallback processes context and should distinguish project facts, models, and assumptions.

how_to_read.id: Jawaban AI adalah layer reasoning; hasil solver/check/project state tetap sumber teknis utama.
how_to_read.en: AI output is a reasoning layer; solver/check/project state remains the primary technical source.

limits.id: AI tidak boleh mengklaim geometry/exporter/measurement yang tidak benar-benar ada.
limits.en: AI must not claim geometry/exporters/measurements that do not actually exist.

next.id: Gunakan assistant untuk menjelaskan finding/result lalu cek data sumbernya.
next.en: Use the assistant to explain findings/results, then inspect their source data.

what.id: Pohon pembelajaran electronics yang menghubungkan teori, rumus/model, implikasi design, batas model, latihan, dan project aktif.
what.en: Electronics learning tree connecting theory, equations/models, design implications, model limits, practice, and the active project.

why.id: Supaya user tahu bukan hanya tombol apa yang dipakai, tetapi alasan fisika/engineering di belakangnya.
why.en: So users understand not only which control to use, but the physics/engineering behind it.

input.id: Curriculum + transcript-grounded expansion + project snapshot.
input.en: Curriculum + transcript-grounded expansion + project snapshot.

process.id: Materi diorganisasi menjadi cabang; Project Lens memetakan topik relevan tanpa menganggap design benar.
process.en: Material is organized into branches; Project Lens maps relevant topics without assuming the design is correct.

output.id: Penjelasan, formula/model, practice, source map, dan lab edukasi.
output.en: Explanations, formulas/models, practice, source map, and educational labs.

how_to_read.id: Learning result adalah pendidikan/model, bukan physical sign-off.
how_to_read.en: Learning output is educational/model content, not physical sign-off.

limits.id: Nilai source yang tampak sebagai error ASR tidak dipromosikan menjadi konstanta terverifikasi.
limits.en: Source values that appear to be ASR errors are not promoted into verified constants.

next.id: Hubungkan materi dengan project lalu validasi menggunakan datasheet/simulator/measurement sesuai levelnya.
next.en: Connect material to the project, then validate using datasheets/simulation/measurement at the appropriate level.

what.id: Peta tahap project dari schematic sampai manufacturing handoff.
what.en: Project-stage map from schematic through manufacturing handoff.

why.id: Membuat status project bisa dijelaskan dan mencegah tahap dianggap selesai hanya karena tombol pernah ditekan.
why.en: Makes project status explainable and prevents stages from being considered complete merely because a button was clicked.

input.id: Project state, ERC, footprints, board geometry, routing, outline, DRC/export readiness.
input.en: Project state, ERC, footprints, board geometry, routing, outline, and DRC/export readiness.

process.id: Setiap tahap dihitung dari state yang tersedia.
process.en: Each stage is computed from available state.

output.en: done/ready/partial/blocked plus reasons and next steps.

how_to_read.id: Blocked adalah penjelasan prerequisite yang belum terpenuhi, bukan sekadar error UI.
how_to_read.en: Blocked explains an unmet prerequisite; it is not merely a UI error.

limits.id: Readiness hanya seakurat source-of-truth tiap engine.
limits.en: Readiness is only as accurate as each engine's source of truth.

next.id: Ikuti prerequisite terdekat yang belum selesai.
next.en: Follow the nearest unmet prerequisite.

what.id: Catatan perubahan per versi.
what.en: Versioned change history.

why.id: Setiap perkembangan harus menjelaskan apa yang berubah, dampaknya, dan batas yang masih tersisa.
why.en: Every development should explain what changed, its impact, and remaining limitations.

input.id: Release/patch metadata.
input.en: Release/patch metadata.

process.id: Versi baru ditambahkan ke history; engine penjelasan juga merekam feature-change event yang dipublikasikan runtime.
process.en: New versions are added to history; the explanation engine also records feature-change events published by the runtime.

how_to_read.id: Patch entry menjelaskan implementasi; status runtime/deploy tetap harus diverifikasi terpisah.
how_to_read.en: Patch entries explain implementation; runtime/deployment status must still be verified separately.

limits.id: Catatan perubahan bukan pengganti test evidence.
limits.en: Change notes are not a substitute for test evidence.

next.id: Buka versi terkait lalu cek feature/result yang berubah.
next.en: Open the relevant version, then inspect the changed feature/result.

what.id: Tahap tidak boleh dilanjutkan karena prerequisite nyata belum terpenuhi.
what.en: The stage must not proceed because a real prerequisite is not satisfied.

why.id: Mencegah hasil palsu atau workflow melompati data yang belum ada.
why.en: Prevents fabricated outputs or skipping missing prerequisites.

input.id: Readiness checks.
input.en: Readiness checks.

process.id: Engine menemukan requirement wajib yang tidak tersedia/invalid.
process.en: The engine found a required item that is unavailable/invalid.

how_to_read.id: Cari prerequisite pertama yang gagal.
how_to_read.en: Find the first failed prerequisite.

limits.id: Blocked tidak selalu berarti bug; sering kali state project memang belum lengkap.
limits.en: Blocked does not always mean a bug; often the project state is genuinely incomplete.

next.id: Penuhi prerequisite lalu refresh/rerun check.
next.en: Satisfy the prerequisite, then refresh/rerun the check.

what.id: Sebagian data/engine ada tetapi belum cukup untuk menyatakan tahap selesai.
what.en: Some data/engine coverage exists but not enough to mark the stage complete.

why.id: Membedakan progress nyata dari completion palsu.
why.en: Distinguishes real progress from false completion.

input.id: Current state + required coverage.
input.en: Current state plus required coverage.

process.id: Readiness engine membandingkan yang sudah tersedia dengan requirement.
process.en: The readiness engine compares available state with requirements.

how_to_read.id: Lihat apa yang sudah valid dan apa yang masih belum.
how_to_read.en: Review what is valid and what is still missing.

limits.id: Partial bukan sign-off.
limits.en: Partial is not sign-off.

next.id: Lengkapi missing items.
next.en: Complete the missing items.

what.id: Fitur/model/output belum tersedia atau input berada di luar coverage engine.
what.en: The feature/model/output is unavailable or the input is outside engine coverage.

why.id: Lebih aman menampilkan keterbatasan daripada memberi hasil dummy.
why.en: Showing a limitation is safer than returning dummy results.

input.id: Feature/model request.
input.en: Feature/model request.

process.id: Coverage check tidak menemukan implementasi/model yang valid.
process.en: Coverage check found no valid implementation/model.

how_to_read.id: Jangan menafsirkan sebagai 0, clean, atau pass.
how_to_read.en: Do not interpret it as zero, clean, or pass.

limits.id: Status dapat berubah di patch berikutnya saat engine benar-benar ditambahkan.
limits.en: The status may change in a later patch when a real engine is added.

next.id: Gunakan metode/model yang tersedia atau tunggu implementasi nyata.
next.en: Use an available method/model or wait for a real implementation.

what.id: Output yang dihasilkan sebuah feature/check/solver dari input dan state saat itu.
what.en: Output produced by a feature/check/solver from the input and state at that moment.

why.id: Hasil harus selalu bisa ditelusuri ke input, proses, model/rule, dan batasannya.
why.en: A result should always be traceable to its input, process, model/rule, and limitations.

input.id: Tergantung feature yang menghasilkan output.
input.en: Depends on the feature producing the output.

process.id: Lihat penjelasan feature sumber untuk mengetahui calculation/rule/model yang digunakan.
process.en: See the source feature explanation to identify the calculation/rule/model used.

output.id: Nilai, finding, readiness, warning, unsupported, atau error.
output.en: Value, finding, readiness, warning, unsupported, or error.

how_to_read.id: Jangan baca angka/status tanpa unit, source, coverage, dan kondisi saat result dibuat.
how_to_read.en: Do not interpret a value/status without its units, source, coverage, and generation conditions.

limits.id: Generic result explanation tidak menggantikan dokumentasi khusus feature.
limits.en: A generic result explanation does not replace feature-specific documentation.

next.id: Klik feature sumber atau gunakan Mode Jelaskan pada panel yang menghasilkan hasil ini.
next.en: Explain the source feature or use Explain Mode on the panel that produced this result.
